description: Implement the Entity/Mob system with GeckoLib integration, Boss framework with phase management, SmartBrainLib AI, NPC/Dialogue system, and Companion system. Includes concrete example entities.
steps: Create CDEGeoEntity.java base class in entity/ extending PathfinderMob implementing GeoEntity: standard cache, registerControllers template, createAttributes helper.
Create GelatinousCubeEntity.java in entity/ following section 7.4 exactly: idle/move/attack animations, 80 HP, 0.18 speed, 8 damage.
Create MimicEntity.java in entity/ with disguise mechanic (looks like chest, activates on proximity).
Create IBossPhase.java interface in api/: getCurrentPhase(), transitionToPhase(), getPhaseHealth(), getPhaseAttacks().
Create BossPhaseManager.java in entity/boss/ managing phase transitions based on health thresholds, firing BossPhasePayload on transition.

Create DyingAtlasEntity.java in entity/boss/ following section 7.5: BossPhase enum (DORMANT through DEATH), AnimationController with phase-based animations, transitionToPhase method with network sync.
Create CDEBrainProvider.java base in entity/ai/ implementing SmartBrainOwner: template for sensors, core tasks, fight tasks.
Create DyingAtlasBrainProvider.java in entity/ai/ following section 7.10: NearbyPlayersSensor, CDEVibrationSensor, CDEPhaseHealthSensor, phase-conditional attack behaviors.
Create custom sensors in entity/ai/: CDEVibrationSensor.java, CDEPhaseHealthSensor.java, CDELightLevelSensor.java, CDEPlayerProximitySensor.java.
Create CDEPhaseConditionalBehavior.java in entity/ai/ for phase-gated attack patterns.
Create CDETelegraphedAreaAttack.java in entity/ai/ for telegraphed boss attacks.
Create DialogueTree.java in entity/npc/ with tree structure: nodes, choices, conditions, actions.
Create DialogueNode.java record in entity/npc/: id, text, List<DialogueChoice>, condition.
Create DialogueChoice.java record in entity/npc/: text, nextNodeId, condition, action.
Create DialogueCondition.java interface in entity/npc/ with test(ServerPlayer) method and implementations: HasItemCondition, ReputationCondition, QuestStateCondition.
Create NPCMemory.java in entity/npc/ tracking per-player interaction history and reputation.
Create NPCEntity.java base in entity/npc/ with dialogue tree, memory, GeckoLib animations.
Create ValdrisEntity.java in entity/npc/ - the merchant NPC with unique dialogue tree.
Create CompanionEntity.java in entity/npc/ with: CompanionState enum (FOLLOW, WAIT, ATTACK, EXPLORE), AI based on current order, inventory, participation in puzzles.
Create CompanionAI.java in entity/npc/ with behavior trees for each CompanionState.
Create CompanionOrder.java enum and CompanionInventory.java in entity/npc/.
Create ICreatureAI.java and ICompanionBehavior.java interfaces in api/.
acceptance_criteria: CDEGeoEntity base class provides AnimatableInstanceCache and controller registration
GelatinousCubeEntity and MimicEntity are complete GeoEntity implementations
DyingAtlasEntity has full BossPhase enum with animation transitions per phase
SmartBrainLib integration with custom sensors and phase-conditional behaviors
DialogueTree supports branching conversations with conditions
CompanionEntity has 4 behavior modes with state machine
All API interfaces (IBossPhase, ICreatureAI, ICompanionBehavior) are in api/ package
verification: DyingAtlasEntity.transitionToPhase sends BossPhasePayload to tracking players
DyingAtlasBrainProvider has sensors and fight tasks matching section 7.10
DialogueTree can traverse nodes based on player choices
CompanionEntity responds to CompanionOrder enum values
findings: All 29 Java files (plus 1 task metadata) created successfully across 5 subsystems: entity/, entity/boss/, entity/ai/, entity/npc/, api/. Cross-references verified: all internal imports resolve to existing mod files, all package declarations match filesystem paths, all brace counts balanced. CDEEntities.java already had placeholder registrations using PathfinderMob::new - these would need updating to reference actual entity constructors when wiring up, but that is expected. SmartBrainLib ExtendedBehaviour.getMemoryRequirements() uses com.mojang.datafixers.util.Pair and net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.memory.MemoryModuleType/MemoryStatus - imports verified correct. Cannot verify full compilation due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode but all referenced NeoForge 1.21.1, GeckoLib 4.x, and SmartBrainLib APIs are correctly imported per their documented packages.
